mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/5dd0db6637c8-t1/ws/prep && cat > /srv/leakruns/5dd0db6637c8-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_94F5 모델링 준비: 예측시점(tp) 단위 코호트·특성·결과 테이블 생성.
학습/성능 계산은 하지 않는다. 설계서·데이터는 읽기만 한다."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_94F5.json").read_text())
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

pat = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
labs = labs.merge(adm[["admission_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}

# --- 예측시점 전개 ---
tps = adm.merge(pat, on="patient_id")
tps = tps.loc[tps.index.repeat(len(design["tp"]["offsets_h"]))].copy()
tps["offset_h"] = np.tile(design["tp"]["offsets_h"], len(adm))
tps["tp"] = tps.admit_time + tps.offset_h * H
tps["in_hospital_at_tp"] = tps.discharge_time > tps.tp
tps["window_end"] = tps.tp + 48 * H
tps["window_beyond_discharge"] = tps.discharge_time < tps.window_end


def kdigo_hit(values, times, ref_vals_7d=None):
    """각 측정이 직전 48h 최솟값+0.3 또는 7일 기준 최솟값×1.5 이상이면 True."""
    hits = []
    for i in range(len(values)):
        prev = (times < times[i]) & (times >= times[i] - 48 * H)
        b48 = values[prev].min() if prev.any() else np.nan
        prev7 = (times < times[i]) & (times >= times[i] - 168 * H)
        b7 = values[prev7].min() if prev7.any() else np.nan
        if ref_vals_7d is not None:
            b7 = np.nanmin([b7, ref_vals_7d]) if not np.isnan(ref_vals_7d) else b7
        hits.append((values[i] >= b48 + 0.3) or (values[i] >= 1.5 * b7))
    return np.array(hits, dtype=bool)


rows = []
for r in tps.itertuples():
    g = cr_by_adm.get(r.admission_id)
    rec = {}
    if g is None or g.empty:
        rec.update(aki_known_by_tp=False, aki_48h=np.nan, n_cr_outcome=0)
        rows.append(rec); continue
    # 제외: tp 시점까지 '보고된' 크레아티닌으로 KDIGO 충족 여부
    known = g[g.report_time <= r.tp]
    kv, kt = known.value.to_numpy(), known.collect_time.to_numpy()
    rec["aki_known_by_tp"] = bool(kdigo_hit(kv, pd.DatetimeIndex(kt)).any()) if len(known) else False
    # 결과: 결과창 (tp, tp+48h] 채취값이 KDIGO 충족 (기준창 tp-168h~tp, 채취시각 기준)
    out = g[(g.collect_time > r.tp) & (g.collect_time <= r.window_end)]
    rec["n_cr_outcome"] = len(out)
    if out.empty:
        rec["aki_48h"] = np.nan
    else:
        hist = g[(g.collect_time <= r.window_end) & (g.collect_time > r.tp - 168 * H)]
        hv, ht = hist.value.to_numpy(), pd.DatetimeIndex(hist.collect_time)
        hit = kdigo_hit(hv, ht)
        rec["aki_48h"] = float(hit[ht > r.tp].any())
    rows.append(rec)
tps = pd.concat([tps.reset_index(drop=True), pd.DataFrame(rows)], axis=1)

# --- 특성 (report_time <= tp 인 값만 사용) ---
def lab_feat(test, start, agg):
    sub = labs[labs.test == test][["admission_id", "value", "report_time", "admit_time"]]
    m = tps[["admission_id", "tp", "admit_time"]].reset_index().merge(sub.drop(columns="admit_time"), on="admission_id")
    lo = m.admit_time if start == "admit" else m.tp - start * H
    m = m[(m.report_time >= lo) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    s = m.groupby("index").value.agg(agg if agg != "count" else "size")
    return s.reindex(tps.index).fillna(0 if agg == "count" else np.nan)

tps["cr_min_adm"] = lab_feat("creatinine", "admit", "min")
tps["k_last"] = lab_feat("potassium", "admit", "last")
tps["bun_last"] = lab_feat("bun", "admit", "last")
tps["cr_max_48h"] = lab_feat("creatinine", 48, "max")
tps["cr_last"] = lab_feat("creatinine", "admit", "last")
tps["hgb_min"] = lab_feat("hemoglobin", "admit", "min")
tps["n_cr"] = lab_feat("creatinine", "admit", "count")
hist = tps[["patient_id", "tp"]].reset_index().merge(adm[["patient_id", "admit_time"]], on="patient_id")
tps["n_admissions_to_tp"] = hist[hist.admit_time <= hist.tp].groupby("index").size().reindex(tps.index).fillna(0)

tps.to_csv(OUT / "tp_dataset_all.csv.gz", index=False)

# --- 코호트 적용 (설계 그대로 + 진단 플래그) ---
coh = tps[(tps.age >= 18) & (~tps.aki_known_by_tp)]
summary = {
    "n_admissions": len(adm), "n_tp_total": len(tps),
    "n_tp_after_discharge": int((~tps.in_hospital_at_tp).sum()),
    "n_tp_cohort_as_designed": len(coh),
    "n_tp_cohort_in_hospital": int(coh.in_hospital_at_tp.sum()),
    "excluded_aki_known_by_tp": int(tps.aki_known_by_tp.sum()),
    "family_id_missing_patients": int(pat.family_id.isna().sum()),
}
c = coh[coh.in_hospital_at_tp]
summary["in_hosp_label_missing(no_cr_in_window)"] = int(c.aki_48h.isna().sum())
summary["in_hosp_window_beyond_discharge"] = int(c.window_beyond_discharge.sum())
summary["in_hosp_aki_rate_by_unit"] = c.groupby("unit").aki_48h.mean().round(4).to_dict()
summary["in_hosp_label_missing_rate_by_unit"] = c.groupby("unit").aki_48h.apply(lambda s: round(s.isna().mean(), 4)).to_dict()
summary["in_hosp_mean_n_cr_outcome_by_unit"] = c.groupby("unit").n_cr_outcome.mean().round(3).to_dict()
summary["after_discharge_label_missing_rate"] = round(coh[~coh.in_hospital_at_tp].aki_48h.isna().mean(), 4)
summary["feature_missing_rate_in_hosp"] = c[[f["name"] for f in design["features"]]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict()

# --- 분할: 설계 키(family_id) 그대로 vs 잠정 대안(family_id 없으면 patient_id) ---
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
key_alt = pat.family_id.fillna(pat.patient_id)
groups = key_alt.unique(); rng.shuffle(groups)
test_groups = set(groups[: int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
split_alt = pat.assign(split_key=key_alt, split=key_alt.map(lambda k: "test" if k in test_groups else "train"))
split_alt[["patient_id", "family_id", "split_key", "split"]].to_csv(OUT / "split_provisional_family_or_patient.csv", index=False)
summary["split_as_designed_nan_family_patients"] = int(pat.family_id.isna().sum())
summary["split_provisional_test_patients"] = int((split_alt.split == "test").sum())

(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
